metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_collapse_score: Mean off-diagonal item-embedding cosine mapped to [0,1], using at most 2048 real items. 0.5 means zero mean cosine; alignment is not behavioral diversity.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-negative score over valid sampled training positions.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_p10: Empirical lower tenth percentile of sampled training margins.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of valid sampled margins below zero.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of valid sampled margins below 0.5.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_category_br: Measured valid, low-margin and wrong-rank counts. Category breakdowns are unavailable. Valid positions require nonzero input, positive and negative IDs. Absent margin samples return null metrics. These are not validation results.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:padding_calibration: At most 16 nonempty training rows from two cached batches, eval/no_grad, autocast and both TF32 flags disabled and then restored. Compare chronological singleton, packed batch, extra left padding, reversed batch order, duplicate rows, repeated execution and fresh-state A-B-A calls. Independent FP64 reference promotes embeddings and all trained GRU weights before arithmetic and uses PyTorch r,z,n equations with both biases. Elementwise tolerance is 1e-5+1.3e-6*abs(reference); absolute-only state tolerance remains 1e-5. Report state/final/score errors, normalized violations and first divergent token with history length. Candidate probes use the first at most 100 real IDs; top10 membership and ordered-list discrepancies are separate row counts over any tested layout. Ordered-list discrepancies can include membership changes; within-set ordering counts only layouts with identical membership but different order. A row may have both kinds across different layouts. Ordering alone does not change HR@10. The minimum tenth/eleventh score gap is descriptive; empirical errors are not certified uniform bounds. Failures confound context attribution and do not alone establish semantic padding leakage. No samples gives null errors/pass flags. These training probes do not measure validation HR@10.
